entry.title: Parallel Experiment
entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：7,99 € → 2,99 € [2,99 € ~ 7,99 €]）

All Price Information

Price：2,99 €

Application Description

IMPORTANT: "Parallel Experiment" is a 2-player cooperative puzzle game with escape room-like elements. Each player must have their own copy on either mobile, tablet, PC or Mac (cross-platform play is supported). In the game players take on the roles of two detectives who are often separated, each with different clues, and must work together to solve puzzles.  Internet connection and voice communication are essential. Need a Player Two? Join our community on Discord! ABOUT THE GAME Parallel Experiment is a noir-inspired adventure with a comic book art style, featuring detectives Ally and Old Dog. While following the trail of the dangerous Cryptic Killer, they suddenly become his targets and are now unwilling participants in his twisted experiment.  This is the second standalone chapter in the “Cryptic Killer” cooperative point-and-click puzzle game series. You can play Unboxing the Cryptic Killer first, if you want to learn more about our detectives and their nemesis, but Parallel Experiment can be enjoyed without prior knowledge. KEY FEATURES - Two Player Co-Op ​In Parallel Experiment, players must rely on their communication skills as they’re separated and must each discover unique clues that are vital for solving puzzles on the other end. Teamwork is essential to crack the Cryptic Killer’s codes. - Challenging Collaborative Puzzles ​There are over 80 puzzles striking the perfect balance between challenging yet fair. But you're not facing them on your own! Communicate with your partner on how to best proceed, solve a puzzle on your end that unlocks the next step for them and discover a wide variety of puzzles from redirecting water flows, finding computer passwords and unlocking intricate locks, to deciphering cryptic ciphers, soldering electronic components, and even waking up a drunk! - Two Can Play That Game ​Looking for a break from the main investigation? Dive into a variety of retro-inspired mini-games designed with a fresh cooperative twist. Challenge each other to darts, Three in a Row, Match Three, Claw Machine, Push and Pull, and more. Think you know these classics? We’ve reinvented them for a whole new co-op experience - Cooperative Dialogues ​Uncover vital clues through collaborative conversations. NPCs respond dynamically to each player, offering new layers of interaction that only teamwork can unravel. Some conversations are puzzles in themselves that you need to solve together! - A story told in panels Our love for comic books shines in Parallel Experiment. Every cutscene is presented as a beautifully crafted comic book page, immersing you in a gripping, noir-inspired narrative. How many pages did we create to tell the story? Almost 100 pages! Even we were surprised by how much it took, but every panel was worth it to deliver a story that keeps you on edge until the very last frame. - Draw on… Everything! ​Every detective needs a notebook. In Parallel Experiment, players can jot down notes, sketch solutions, and interact with the environment in creative ways. But we all know what you're going to draw first… - Annoy Each Other ​This is a key feature? Yes. Yes, it is. ​ ​Each level will have some way for players to annoy their co-op partner: knock on a window to distract them, poke them, make their screens shake. You already know you'll be doing this just by reading it, right? Parallel Experiment has a variety of mind-twisting challenges that push the boundaries of cooperative puzzle design, offering situations never seen before in other games.

entry.title: Unboxing the Cryptic Killer
entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：2,99 € → 1,99 € [0,99 € ~ 2,99 €]）

All Price Information

Price：1,99 €

Application Description

SOLVE A CRYPTIC BOX Unboxing the Cryptic Killer is the first standalone chapter to the cooperative point-and-click puzzle game series 'Cryptic Killer'. Join forces with a friend and play as detective partners Ally and Old Dog in our debut two-player escape room adventure. IMPORTANT: "Unboxing the Cryptic Killer" is a 2-player cooperative puzzle game, that requires each player to have their own copy on either mobile, tablet, PC or Mac. Internet connection and voice communication are essential. Need a Player Two? Join our Discord community! Two seasoned detectives, Ally and Old Dog, are entangled in a chilling unsolved case. Lured on a perilous trail, they fall into the clutches of the enigmatic Cryptic Killer they've been relentlessly pursuing. The stakes are sky-high as two innocent lives hang in the balance. In order to save them, Ally and Old Dog must unravel a box of intricate puzzles masterfully designed by the nefarious killer. Test your mettle and join this high-stakes race against time, where every puzzle solved is a step closer to unmasking the Cryptic Killer. THE ONLY WAY TO ESCAPE IS TO WORK TOGETHER Unboxing the Cryptic Killer is a puzzle for exactly two players. The name of the game is collaboration. Each player takes on one of the two roles and works their way through a series of challenging puzzles. You'll each see one half of the same puzzle and must work together to crack the codes and escape the Cryptic Killer's clutches. FEATURES LIST ▶Two Player Co-Op In Unboxing the Cryptic Killer, the detectives are separated. You’ll see different items and clues than your partner, and will be tested on your communication! ▶Challenging Collaborative Puzzles Two brains are better than one when it comes to cracking the Cryptic Killer's codes. ▶Unravel a Thrilling Story Track the Cryptic Killer's movements as Detectives Old Dog and Ally in this ongoing murder mystery saga. ▶Explore Illustrated Worlds Unboxing the Cryptic Killer features hand-illustrated environments that are inspired by noir novels. ▶Draw on… Everything! You cannot solve a case without taking notes. At any time in the game, you can whip out a notebook and pen to make notes and scribble on your environment.

致所有热爱《安尼姆》的玩家： 这一次，我们做了款永不落幕的单机版！ 各位新老玩家朋友们，好久不见。 为什么我们要把《安尼姆的无尽旅途》从网游改成单机版？ 其实原因很简单，也很纯粹： 一是想给一直支持我们的玩家，留一个"可以持续游玩的地方"。不用再担心服务器关闭，某天突然就玩不到了，这份陪伴不该被运营问题打断； 二是想弥补遗憾。网游版的运营一直举步维艰，更让我们愧疚的是，当初的设计框架导致游戏体验不够稳定，这些问题困扰了大家很久，也成了我们心里的疙瘩。所以我们想在最后，把游戏最基础、最核心的体验做好，完整地交到喜欢《安尼姆》的人手里。这是我们项目组能做，也应该做的事。 从网游到单机，这是一次艰难的转型，也是一次勇敢的重生。我们深知这款游戏还不够完美，但它始终承载着"不让热爱落幕"的初心。如果你是老玩家，欢迎回来重拾回忆；如果你喜欢暗黑地牢类游戏，也期待你能来探索这个世界。 下面和大家详细说说单机版的核心改动，每一处都为了更纯粹的游玩体验： 1、彻底删除所有氪金系统，买断制一次付费，畅玩到底； 2、新增"游戏月"机制：替代原网游24小时现实刷新，主线需在倒计时内完成（简单/普通难度时间充裕，高难度更具挑战），同时承载游戏内刷新功能； 3、角色全免费招募：取消固定角色徽章，改为通用徽章升级，招募与升级方式需要大家自行探索； 4、新增旁白系统：强化剧情沉浸感，带你更深入走进安尼姆的世界； 5、角色永久死亡：一旦阵亡无法复活、无法重招，每一步选择都要谨慎； 6、即时存档功能：随开随玩； 7、装备系统优化：提升罗盘秘境产出，降低装备打磨成本和火炼难度，减负更护肝。 我们知道，这次转型可能会有不完美的地方，但每一处改动都凝聚着我们的诚意。老玩家们，这里依然是你们熟悉的安尼姆，却有了更纯粹的冒险；新朋友们，欢迎你们加入这场旅途。

Military Retirement is a stand alone application intended to assist military personnel from all branches of military service by informing them of their benefits upon retirement from military service. Application Description

Overview DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Dark Prince comes to smartphones! Compose your very own team of monsters from across the Dragon Quest series and engage in thrilling battles against your foes. Recruit monsters from the wild world around you and combine them to synthesize new creatures as you see fit. With over 500 monsters to choose from and a revamped synthesis system to explore, you can mix and match to you heart's content to create your favorite cute critters and dastardly supervillains, as well as brand-new additions to the monstrous roll call. Your quest to become the greatest monster wrangler of all time starts here! Story This is the tale of Psaro, a young man cursed, and the adventure upon which he and his trusted friends embark. When the curse put upon him by his father, the Master of Monsterkind, renders him incapable of harming any creature of monster blood, Psaro vows to become a monster wrangler in order to break the spell. On his journey, he will befriend many monsters, train them to be stronger, synthesize powerful new allies and take on ever more dangerous foes. Join Psaro and his friends on their campaign for monster-wrangling glory! (The network mode Online Battles from the console version, where players battle one another in real time, is not included.) Game Features - Explore Nadiria, the Magical Monster Realm On his quest for greatness, Psaro will traverse the multifarious Circles of Nadiria. Whether it be made entirely of cake and sweets or fraught with rivers of bubbling lava, each Circle plays host to a wealth of bewitching adventures. As time passes in Nadiria, so too do the seasons change, with different weather conditions tempting new monsters out of hiding and revealing paths to undiscovered areas. The Circles of Nadiria are sure to provide a fresh experience every time you visit. - Over 500 Unique Monsters With such varied environments to explore, you can expect them to be inhabited by a plethora of monsters. While many can be recruited in battle, occasionally a defeated monster will ask to join your team of its own accord. Befriend as many monsters as you can, then combine them to synthesize new creatures and build a unique party to your exact liking. - Enjoy All the DLC from the Console Version The smartphone version includes the DLC packs from the console version: the Mole Hole, Coach Joe's Dungeon Gym and Treasure Trunks. Make the most of their unique features to enhance your adventure. - Test Your Might Against Other Players Register your team for the network mode Quickfire Contests to participate in automated battles against the party data of 30 other players. Once a day you can earn stat-boosting items as a prize, and the monsters from any team you defeat will be added to your roster (up to rank B monsters only). Recommended Device Specifications - iPhone 11 or later - iPad (10th generation) or later - iPad mini (6th generation) or later - iPad Air (5th generation) or later - iPad Pro (4th generation) or later Graphics settings can be adjusted to improve performance. Running the game on devices that do not meet the recommended specifications can result in crashes due to insufficient memory, or other unexpected errors. We are unable to provide support for devices that do not meet the recommended specifications. OS Compatibility iOS 13.0 or later

Application Description

******************** Esta aventura grandiosa, que se desenrola por três gerações, já está disponível para ser jogada na palma de sua mão! Junte-se a uma família de heróis, compartilhando todos os triunfos e tragédias de suas vidas repletas de acontecimentos! Divirta-se com três gerações de aventuras em um pacote único! Baixe uma vez e não terá mais nada para comprar e nem para baixar! *O texto no jogo só está disponível em inglês. ******************** ◆Prólogo Nosso herói começa a história como um garotinho, viajando pelo mundo com seu pai, Pankraz. Ao longo de suas muitas aventuras, esse adorável rapaz aprende e cresce. E quando finalmente se torna um homem, ele decide continuar a busca inacabada de seu pai: encontrar o Herói Lendário... Você já pode se divertir com essa história empolgante e de dimensões extraordinárias em dispositivos de bolso! ◆Recursos do jogo ・Faça amizade com monstros poderosos! Os temíveis monstros que você enfrenta agora podem virar seus amigos, dando a você acesso a magias e capacidades únicas, além de uma série de possibilidades estratégicas! ・Converse livremente com seus companheiros de grupo! A função bate-papo de grupo permite que você converse livremente com o elenco de personagens coloridos que irão acompanhá-lo em suas aventuras. Por isso, não hesite em pedir conselhos ou bater um papo com eles sempre que der vontade! ・Perspectivas de 360 graus Você pode alterar o seu ponto de vista para qualquer lado que quiser, para ter certeza que não perderá nada! ・Batalhas com IA Cansado de dar ordens? Seus leais companheiros podem ser instruídos a lutar automaticamente! Use as diversas táticas à sua disposição para liquidar com facilidade até mesmo seus inimigos mais difíceis! ・O cassino Com máquinas caça-níqueis, pôquer, a arena de monstros e as empolgantes corridas de meleca do nojentódromo, o cassino certamente irá proporcionar a você um pouco de alívio quando as pressões das aventuras forem grandes demais. Melhor ainda, você pode trocar as fichas que ganhar por todos os tipos de itens, o que faz do lazer algo que vale realmente a pena! ・Tesouros e alçapões Pegue os dados e jogue-os para avançar por tabuleiros especialmente projetados e divirta-se com diversos eventos empolgantes! Algumas das coisas que você verá não estarão disponíveis em nenhum outro lugar. E se você conseguir chegar ao fim, poderá ganhar prêmios sensacionais! ・Bata na Meleca está de volta! Bata na Meleca, o minijogo de golpear meleca apresentado na versão para Nintendo DS, voltou com tudo! Bata nas melecas dentro do limite de tempo para ganhar pontos nesse jogo maluco, supersimples e viciante! ・Controles simples e intuitivos Os controles do jogo foram projetados para funcionar perfeitamente com o design vertical de qualquer dispositivo móvel moderno, e a posição do botão de movimento pode ser mudada para facilitar o jogo tanto com uma como com duas mãos. ・Experimente o RPG lendário que é amado por milhões no Japão e em todo o mundo! Criado por um lendário trio, com as ideias do mestre-criador Yuji Horii, pelas composições e orquestrações para sintetizador feitas por Koichi Sugiyama, e pela arte do mestre do mangá Akira Toriyama (Dragon Ball). --------------------
